original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚NGO呼吁媒体合作，推动生殖健康议题的伦理报道
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚非政府组织“性暴力与性别暴力司法倡导网络”（SJN）呼吁与媒体合作，推动生殖健康议题的伦理报道。SJN全国协调人Jerome Uneje在奥绍博为记者和内容创作者举办的培训上表示，培训旨在让记者了解《安全终止妊娠（STOP）指南》，并以人权视角报道性与生殖健康权利议题。该消息来自单一来源尼日利亚通讯社（NAN）。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚非政府组织SJN呼吁与媒体合作，推动生殖健康议题的伦理报道
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A non-governmental organisation (NGO), The Sexual and Gender-Based Violence (SGBV) Justice Advocacy Network (SJN), has called for collaboration with the media to promote ethical coverage and reportage of reproductive health issues in Nigeria.

key_facts.fact: SJN全国协调人Jerome Uneje在奥绍博为记者和内容创作者举办培训
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The National Coordinator of SJN, Ms. Jerome Uneje, made the call during a one-day training for journalists and content creators on Rights-Based Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights (SRHR) Reporting and Ethical Coverage of Reproductive Health Issues on Tuesday in Osogbo.

key_facts.fact: 培训旨在让记者了解《安全终止妊娠（STOP）指南》
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Uneje said the training was aimed at educating journalists on the national guidelines on the Safe Termination of Pregnancy (STOP) guidelines and promoting ethical, rights-based reporting of reproductive health issues.

key_facts.fact: SJN由七个成员组织组成，致力于预防和应对性暴力与性别暴力
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: SJN is a coalition of seven member organisations comprising women’s rights groups, women-led enterprises, media practitioners and other key stakeholders.

key_facts.fact: 该报道来自单一来源尼日利亚通讯社（NAN）

uncertainties: 该事件目前仅有一个来源（尼日利亚通讯社NAN），尚缺乏交叉验证
